verdict.rationale: Typesense can run headlessly as a standalone server via Docker/binary installs with no GUI dependency, confirmed by a runtime probe showing CLI install and a scripted index+search roundtrip with no account required, and docs explicitly cover 'Running Tests in Github Actions' and 'Testcontainers' for CI use. However, there is no dedicated CI/automation guide or first-party example pipeline beyond passing mentions. missing for 10: a dedicated CI/CD pipeline example or GitHub Action, independent hands-on report of running Typesense fully headless in an automated pipeline, and broader documentation on non-interactive/unattended operation beyond the brief testcontainers/GH Actions mention.
